profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ALG
profile.summary: A multipurpose software engineer with seven years of experience in big data, machine learning, and forecasting primarily using the .Net stack. Currently interested in Software as a Service (SaaS) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA). Keeping an eye on Blazor.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Developer Contract
positions.description:
•Re-engineered primary data mining system to a distributed, microservice-based model to address limitations with legacy business systems. Redesigned, developed, and tested system to process tens of millions of rows of data despite legacy 32-bit systems in the production environment using C#, WCF, and WPF. Results written directly to Microsoft Excel reports.

•Designed, developed, and tested system to calculate business metrics relating to supply chain inventory and returns.

•Designed and developed system to acquire and catalog data from external services for internal business reporting using C#, Dapper, and Microsoft SQL Server.

•Designed, developed, tested, deployed, and maintained an internal web app to determine and report on warehouse, product allocation, and related purchase orders using C#, .Net MVC Core, Entity Framework, and Dapper.

positions.title: Manager - Planning and Allocations
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
•Designed, developed, tested, and maintained data mining system in C# to provide key business sales insights and reporting for warehouse accounts to support sales and product teams with publishing and sales decisions. 

•Created and established new business rules and metrics to improve product creation, sales, and product allocation processes increasing sales by 3-5% yearly, reducing return rates by up to ten points each year compared to 2010-2012 levels, and reducing internal order errors by 90%.

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed and determined best-fit allocation of home video product across all relevant product descriptors including genre, age, format, and audience for all Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) retail sales channels. Updated analyst tools for usability, reliability, performance, and accuracy.

Technologies used: Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel, C#, .Net Framework, Teradata.
